corn-yield-predictor.label: Trend corn yield, 2026
corn-yield-predictor.headline: 188 bu/acre
corn-yield-predictor.detail: Lincoln County, NE yields since 2000 rise about 1.3 bu/acre a year. In 1 year in 10 the county falls below 171.
corn-yield-predictor.source: USDA NASS county corn yields (all practices), 2000 on
corn-yield-predictor.method: Straight-line trend through the county's yields; the low end is the 10th percentile of each year's yield relative to its trend. County averages, not a forecast of this season.

farm-equipment-planner.label: Fall field days, Oct 1 to Nov 30
farm-equipment-planner.headline: 54 of 61 days
farm-equipment-planner.detail: Lincoln County, NE: workable days in a typical fall since 2000; in a wet fall (1 in 10) about 50. Wettest: 2008, with 48. Counts rain only, not snow or frozen ground.
farm-equipment-planner.source: NASA POWER daily rainfall, 2000 on (via the Yield Predictor)
farm-equipment-planner.method: Workable day = under 2.5 mm of rain that day and under 12.5 mm over the two days before. Typical = median fall; wet = 10th percentile.

grazing-planner.label: Grass this season, 2026
grazing-planner.headline: 7% below normal
grazing-planner.detail: Lincoln County, NE grassland: about 1,807 lb an acre this season against a normal 1,945 (forecast as of August 1). 8 in 10: 1,684 to 1,912.
grazing-planner.source: Rangeland Analysis Platform (USDA Agricultural Research Service) and NASA POWER weather, via the Grazing Planner
grazing-planner.method: The Grazing Planner's own answer for the county's grassland on its latest check date: grass grown so far plus the forecast for the rest of the season, against the county's average over the 10 seasons before. The range is where 8 in 10 seasons landed around forecasts made on the same date.
